cooked: Treat payment type as a property of the payment, not a choice users must learn upfront. Detect the invoice or address, then label the confirmation screen “Lightning” or “on-chain” with the relevant fee and settlement expectations. Put the recovery caveat beside backup creation: a seed may restore on-chain funds, while Lightning recovery can depend on the wallet’s channel-backup design and service. Repeat it in recovery instructions, not just onboarding.
topic_title: Where should wallets explain the differences between on-chain Bitcoin and Lightning?
